questions.stem: A student has 4 g of magnesium and 10 g of oxygen for the reaction 2Mg + O₂ → 2MgO. Which statement is correct? (Ar: Mg = 24, O = 16)

options.text: Oxygen is the limiting reactant because it has fewer moles
Magnesium is limiting because it has a smaller mass
Magnesium is the limiting reactant because it will be used up first
Neither is limiting because both are present in excess

questions.explanation: Moles of Mg = 4/24 = 0.167 mol. Moles of O₂ = 10/32 = 0.3125 mol. From the equation, 2 mol Mg needs 1 mol O₂, so 0.167 mol Mg needs 0.0835 mol O₂. We have 0.3125 mol O₂, which is more than enough. Magnesium is the limiting reactant.
